title: Tunneling phase diagram: A machine-learning framework for multidimensional kinetic isotope effects
summary: The kinetic isotope effect (KIE) is the conventional probe for quantum tunneling, yet its composite nature conflates tunneling with zero-point energy and classical kinetics. Here, we introduce the tunneling phase diagram, a machine-learning framework that decouples true tunneling strength by decoding the nonlinear relationship between KIE and the tunneling factor (\k{appa}). With exceptional fidelity (R^2 > 0.98, RMSE = 0.21), this framework reveals an anomalous high KIE-low \k{appa} spanning 300-600 K, thereby defining a paradigm for the quantitative assessment of quantum tunneling.
